name: tavily
label: Tavily
description: Search engine tailored for AI agents.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your Tavily API Key:

1. Visit [tavily](https://tavily.com/) and create an account.
2. Log in and navigate to your dashboard.
3. Locate and copy your API key from the dashboard.

search.label: Search
search.description: Search for data based on a query.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: The search query you want to execute with Tavily.

search_depth.label: Search Depth
search_depth.description: The depth of the search. It can be "basic" or "advanced".

topic.label: Topic
topic.description: The category of the search. This will determine which of our agents will be used for the search.

days.label: Days
days.description: The number of days back from the current date to include in the search results. Only available when using the "news" search topic. Default is 3.

time_range.label: Time Range
time_range.description: The time range back from the current date to include in the search results.

max_results.label: Maximum Results
max_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return.

include_images.label: Include Images
include_images.description: Include a list of query-related images in the response.

include_image_descriptions.label: Include Image Descriptions
include_image_descriptions.description: When include_images is set to True, this option adds descriptive text for each image.

include_answer.label: Include Answer
include_answer.description: Include a short answer to original query, generated by an LLM based on Tavily's search results.

include_raw_content.label: Include Raw Content
include_raw_content.description: Include the cleaned and parsed HTML content of each search result.

include_domains.label: Include Domains
include_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically include in the search results.

exclude_domains.label: Exclude Domains
exclude_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically exclude from the search results.

tavily_crawl_website.label: Crawl Website
tavily_crawl_website.description: Crawl a website starting from a root URL and return the content of the pages found.

url.label: Root URL
url.description: The root URL to begin the crawl from.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.description: Natural language instructions describing what the crawler should look for.

max_depth.label: Max Depth
max_depth.description: How far from the root URL the crawler can explore. Range: 1-5.

max_breadth.label: Max Breadth
max_breadth.description: Maximum number of links to follow per level of the tree. Range: 1-500.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Total number of links the crawler will process before stopping.

select_paths.label: Select Paths
select_paths.description: Regex patterns selecting only URLs with these path patterns.

select_domains.label: Select Domains
select_domains.description: Regex patterns selecting only specific domains or subdomains.

exclude_paths.label: Exclude Paths
exclude_paths.description: Regex patterns excluding URLs with these path patterns.

exclude_domains.label: Exclude Domains
exclude_domains.description: Regex patterns excluding specific domains or subdomains.

allow_external.label: Allow External Links
allow_external.description: Include external domain links in the final results list.

include_images.label: Include Images
include_images.description: Include images found on the crawled pages.

extract_depth.label: Extract Depth
extract_depth.description: The depth of content extraction per page.

format.label: Format
format.description: The format of the extracted page content.

tavily_map_website.label: Map Website
tavily_map_website.description: Crawl a website starting from a root URL and return the URL structure discovered, without page content.

url.label: Root URL
url.description: The root URL to begin the mapping from.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.description: Natural language instructions guiding the crawler.

max_depth.label: Max Depth
max_depth.description: How far from the root URL the crawler can explore. Range: 1-5.

max_breadth.label: Max Breadth
max_breadth.description: Maximum number of links to follow per level of the tree. Range: 1-500.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Total number of links the crawler will process before stopping.

select_paths.label: Select Paths
select_paths.description: Regex patterns selecting only URLs with these path patterns.

select_domains.label: Select Domains
select_domains.description: Regex patterns selecting only specific domains or subdomains.

exclude_paths.label: Exclude Paths
exclude_paths.description: Regex patterns excluding URLs with these path patterns.

exclude_domains.label: Exclude Domains
exclude_domains.description: Regex patterns excluding specific domains or subdomains.

allow_external.label: Allow External Links
allow_external.description: Include external domain links in the final results list.

tavily_start_research_task.label: Start Research Task
tavily_start_research_task.description: Start an asynchronous, in-depth research task on a topic or question.

input.label: Research Question
input.description: The research task or question to investigate.

model.label: Model
model.description: "mini" for targeted research, "pro" for comprehensive multi-angle analysis.

citation_format.label: Citation Format
citation_format.description: Citation style used in the report.

include_domains.label: Include Domains
include_domains.description: Soft preference domains; research prioritizes these. Max 20.

exclude_domains.label: Exclude Domains
exclude_domains.description: Hard blocklist; no URLs from these domains appear. Max 20.

tavily_get_research_task.label: Get Research Task
tavily_get_research_task.description: Get the status and result of a research task by its request id.

request_id.label: Request ID
request_id.description: The request id returned by Start Research Task.

include_usage.label: Include Usage
include_usage.description: Include credit usage information in the response.

tavily_get_usage.label: Get Usage
tavily_get_usage.description: Get API key and account credit usage for the connected Tavily account.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: Optional project id to scope the usage query to a specific project.
